messages:
Anna: Quick sync — monthly recurring-incident pattern review for last quarter. I pulled the high-level trends and we have 3 recurring themes: 1) model OOMs driven by long-context requests and quantized kernels; 2) autoscaler misconfig for Dedicated pools during burst traffic; 3) 3rd-party auth token expiry leading to cascading request failures.

Anna: I want to convert this into action items with owners + timelines. Proposed quick sync Thu 4/18 11:00 PT — if you can't make it drop notes here.

Diego: +1. I can pull trend charts from observability and attach counts by cause. Will post a short CSV by EOD. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Kevin: I already exported SLO breach counts last week — gist has weekly counts. Top 3 causes match Anna's list. Suggest adding a Grafana panel and an alert rule.

Sara: On OOMs: root cause is often unbounded user-provided context + quantized kernel memory behavior. Short-term mitigation: per-model context cap + graceful fallback to smaller batch / CPU fallback path. Owner: Sara. ETA: 2 weeks (target 2024-05-02).@Anna please stitch this into follow-ups.

Mike: Autoscaler notes: minReplicas too low for some dedicated pools and no surge policy on bursty routes. Plan: update HPA config, add surge policy and a synthetic load test. Owner: Mike. ETA: 1 week (2024-04-25). I'll open a PR (will link).

Anna: Action items (initial):
1) OOM mitigations — Sara — 2024-05-02
2) Autoscaler surge policy + tests — Mike — 2024-04-25
3) Token expiry retry flow + CI test — Diego — 2024-04-30
4) Quarterly dashboard + alerts — Kevin — 2024-04-22
I'll track these on the incident follow-up board and ping weekly. :spiral_calendar:

Diego: For token expiries — found many 401s in support logs where client didn't refresh token and we returned no retry. Quick fix: add retry+refresh path for 401s on upstream auth, and add synthetic e2e for token rotation. Owner: Diego. ETA 1 week.

Kevin: I'll add Grafana query: `sum by(cause) (incident_count{environment=~"prod|dedicated"})` and an alert if same cause > 3 incidents in 30d. Also propose an automated monthly digest to owners with top causes.

Incident Bot: New follow-ups added to board: INC-FOLLOWUP-234 (OOM mitigations), INC-FOLLOWUP-235 (Autoscaler surge), INC-FOLLOWUP-236 (Auth retry).

Anna: Can someone capture the forensic notes per theme? I can draft the high-level doc but need the technical snippets (kernel logs, config diffs). If you open PRs, paste links here.

Sara: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/789 — adds per-model context guard + fallback to CPU path. @Kevin @Mike PTAL.

Mike: Reviewed & approved. Deploying to staging now. Will report perf numbers after smoke tests.

Diego: CI test for auth refresh added: tests/auth/test_refresh.py — local pass, CI queued. Will link pipeline when green.

Anna: Awesome, thanks. I'll update the follow-up board and schedule a check-in in two weeks to close or re-scope items. If anything blocks, drop a message here or DM me. :rocket:
